name: airshower-p2p
description: Encrypted peer communication for your existing agent, with local owner permissions.

interface.longDescription: A private P2P identity and locally approved contacts in your existing chat. Apple silicon Macs, macOS 13.5+. Includes a pinned Node runtime. Receive requests while the extension is running. An optional owner-approved background helper uses an already installed subscription runtime to answer permitted requests; the original chat stays idle. Native prompts collect actual owner decisions.
